name: Previously returned original work recovered by human same-owner MOVE and empty Free Cities carrier return

condition.code:
local stage=Game:GetProperty('JAC_NATIVE_AI_MOVE_PROBE')
if not stage or stage.Stage~='FREE_CUSTODY_PROVED' then return false end
local free=CityManager.GetCityAt(stage.Carrier.X,stage.Carrier.Y)
local human=CityManager.GetCityAt(129,35)
return free and free:GetOwner()==stage.Carrier.Free and free:GetID()==stage.Carrier.FreeCity
 and free:GetBuildings():GetGreatWorkInSlot(stage.Carrier.Building,stage.Carrier.Slot)==stage.Index
 and human and human:GetOwner()==1 and human:GetBuildings():GetGreatWorkInSlot(12,0)==-1

steps.code:
local A=assert(JAC_AbsorptionGameplay)
local stage=assert(Game:GetProperty('JAC_NATIVE_AI_MOVE_PROBE'))
local city=assert(CityManager.GetCityAt(stage.Carrier.X,stage.Carrier.Y))
assert(city:GetOwner()==stage.Carrier.Free and city:GetID()==stage.Carrier.FreeCity,'original Free Cities carrier identity changed')
local original=A.NativeWorkLocations(stage.Index)
assert(#original==1 and original[1].Owner==stage.Carrier.Free and original[1].CityID==city:GetID()
 and original[1].Building==stage.Carrier.Building and original[1].Slot==stage.Carrier.Slot,'original work not uniquely at Free Cities source')
local human=assert(CityManager.GetCityAt(129,35))
assert(human:GetOwner()==1 and A.CityAssets(human).BUILDING_TEMPLE.Works[0]==-1,'human recovery Temple occupied')
local assets=A.CityAssets(city)
assets.BUILDING_TEMPLE.Works[0]=-1
local plan={Index=stage.Index,Source={Owner=stage.Carrier.Free,City=stage.Carrier.FreeCity,X=stage.Carrier.X,Y=stage.Carrier.Y,Building=stage.Carrier.Building,Slot=stage.Carrier.Slot},
 Dest={Owner=1,City=human:GetID(),X=human:GetX(),Y=human:GetY(),Building=12,Slot=0},
 Original=stage.Source,Before={Population=city:GetPopulation(),Name=city:GetName(),Assets=assets,Loyalty=A.CityLoyalty(city),Religion=A.CityReligion(city)},Stage='BORROW_INTENT'}
Game:SetProperty('JAC_NATIVE_REVERSE_CARRIER',plan)
CityManager.TransferCity(city,1)
return 'work-bearing Free Cities carrier transferred to human before same-owner recovery MOVE'

steps.code:
local plan=assert(Game:GetProperty('JAC_NATIVE_REVERSE_CARRIER'))
local carrier=assert(CityManager.GetCityAt(plan.Source.X,plan.Source.Y))
local dest=assert(CityManager.GetCityAt(plan.Dest.X,plan.Dest.Y))
assert(carrier:GetOwner()==1 and dest:GetOwner()==1 and carrier:GetID()~=dest:GetID(),'human same-owner recovery cities not distinct')
assert(carrier:GetBuildings():GetGreatWorkInSlot(plan.Source.Building,plan.Source.Slot)==plan.Index and dest:GetBuildings():GetGreatWorkInSlot(plan.Dest.Building,plan.Dest.Slot)==-1,'recovery source or destination changed')
local params={}
params[PlayerOperations.PARAM_PLAYER_ONE]=1
params[PlayerOperations.PARAM_CITY_SRC]=carrier:GetID()
params[PlayerOperations.PARAM_CITY_DEST]=dest:GetID()
params[PlayerOperations.PARAM_BUILDING_SRC]=plan.Source.Building
params[PlayerOperations.PARAM_BUILDING_DEST]=plan.Dest.Building
params[PlayerOperations.PARAM_GREAT_WORK_INDEX]=plan.Index
params[PlayerOperations.PARAM_SLOT]=plan.Dest.Slot
local returned=UI.RequestPlayerOperation(Game.GetLocalPlayer(),PlayerOperations.MOVE_GREAT_WORK,params)
ExposedMembers.JAC_NativeReverseMove={SourceCity=carrier:GetID(),TargetCity=dest:GetID(),Index=plan.Index}
print('[JAC_NATIVE_REVERSE_MOVE_REQUEST] actor='..Game.GetLocalPlayer()..' result='..tostring(returned)..' source='..carrier:GetID()..' target='..dest:GetID())
return 'human same-owner MOVE requested; physical recovery still unproven'

local plan=assert(Game:GetProperty('JAC_NATIVE_REVERSE_CARRIER'))
local carrier=assert(CityManager.GetCityAt(plan.Source.X,plan.Source.Y))
local human=assert(CityManager.GetCityAt(plan.Dest.X,plan.Dest.Y))
local src=carrier:GetBuildings():GetGreatWorkInSlot(plan.Source.Building,plan.Source.Slot)
local dst=human:GetBuildings():GetGreatWorkInSlot(plan.Dest.Building,plan.Dest.Slot)
local count=0;local found
local owners,seen={},{}
for _,owner in ipairs(PlayerManager.GetAliveIDs()) do if not seen[owner] then owners[#owners+1]=owner;seen[owner]=true end end
if not seen[plan.Source.Owner] then owners[#owners+1]=plan.Source.Owner end
for _,owner in ipairs(owners) do local p=Players[owner];if p then for _,city in p:GetCities():Members() do
 local b=city:GetBuildings();for def in GameInfo.Buildings() do if b:HasBuilding(def.Index) then
  for slot=0,b:GetNumGreatWorkSlots(def.Index)-1 do if b:GetGreatWorkInSlot(def.Index,slot)==plan.Index then count=count+1;found={Owner=owner,City=city:GetID(),X=city:GetX(),Y=city:GetY(),Building=def.Index,Slot=slot} end end
 end end end end end
ExposedMembers.JAC_NativeReversePhysical={Count=count,Source=src,Dest=dst,Found=found}
print('[JAC_NATIVE_REVERSE_MOVE_PHYSICAL] count='..count..' source='..tostring(src)..' dest='..tostring(dst))
return 'human same-owner recovery scan count='..count

local A=assert(JAC_AbsorptionGameplay)
local plan=assert(Game:GetProperty('JAC_NATIVE_REVERSE_CARRIER'))
local proof=assert(ExposedMembers.JAC_NativeReversePhysical)
assert(proof.Count==1 and proof.Source==-1 and proof.Dest==plan.Index,'human same-owner recovery MOVE did not physically finish')
local found=A.NativeWorkLocations(plan.Index)
assert(#found==1 and found[1].Owner==1 and found[1].CityID==plan.Dest.City and found[1].X==plan.Dest.X and found[1].Y==plan.Dest.Y and found[1].Building==plan.Dest.Building and found[1].Slot==plan.Dest.Slot,'original work missed exact human recovery Temple')
local carrier=assert(CityManager.GetCityAt(plan.Source.X,plan.Source.Y))
assert(carrier:GetOwner()==1 and A.CityAssets(carrier).BUILDING_TEMPLE.Works[0]==-1,'borrowed carrier still holds a work')
plan.Stage='RETURN_INTENT';plan.BorrowedCity=carrier:GetID();Game:SetProperty('JAC_NATIVE_REVERSE_CARRIER',plan)
CityManager.TransferCity(carrier,plan.Source.Owner)
return 'empty carrier returned to Free Cities after original work reached human Temple'

steps.code:
local A=assert(JAC_AbsorptionGameplay)
local plan=assert(Game:GetProperty('JAC_NATIVE_REVERSE_CARRIER'))
local carrier=assert(CityManager.GetCityAt(plan.Source.X,plan.Source.Y))
local human=assert(CityManager.GetCityAt(plan.Dest.X,plan.Dest.Y))
assert(carrier:GetOwner()==plan.Source.Owner and human:GetOwner()==1,'carrier or recovery destination owner changed')
local found=A.NativeWorkLocations(plan.Index)
assert(#found==1 and found[1].Owner==1 and found[1].CityID==human:GetID() and found[1].X==plan.Dest.X and found[1].Y==plan.Dest.Y and found[1].Building==plan.Dest.Building and found[1].Slot==plan.Dest.Slot,'original index not uniquely at human Temple')
assert(A.CityAssets(carrier).BUILDING_TEMPLE.Works[0]==-1,'Free Cities original carrier slot not empty')
for _,key in ipairs({'GreatWorkType','ObjectType','CreatorName','TurnCreated','CreatedByPlayer'}) do assert(plan.Original[key]==found[1][key],'original recovered metadata changed: '..key) end
assert(A.Rules.Equal(plan.Original.Effects,found[1].Effects),'original recovered effects changed')
local after={Population=carrier:GetPopulation(),Name=carrier:GetName(),Assets=A.CityAssets(carrier),Loyalty=A.CityLoyalty(carrier),Religion=A.CityReligion(carrier)}
print('[JAC_NATIVE_REVERSE_CARRIER_EFFECTS] before='..A.Canonical(plan.Before)..' after='..A.Canonical(after))
assert(A.Rules.Equal(plan.Before,after),'Free Cities carrier changed after empty return')
plan.Stage='RECOVERY_PHYSICAL_PROVED';plan.FreeCity=carrier:GetID();Game:SetProperty('JAC_NATIVE_REVERSE_CARRIER',plan)
print('[JAC_NATIVE_REVERSE_RECOVERED] index='..plan.Index..' owner='..found[1].Owner..' city='..found[1].CityID)
return 'original index physically recovered and empty carrier restored to Free Cities'
